_comment: Canonical env-var manifest for the fbt-calculator-api Cloud Run service. Consumed by three sites in .github/workflows/deploy.yml (pre-deploy live-set check + Deploy step --set-env-vars + post-deploy presence assertion) and by scripts/check_deploy_placeholders.py which scans it as the single source of truth. All three consumers read from this file so a matched-drift blind spot cannot exist (mc40-2026-08-29 Andrew follow-up 1: cross-checking two documents that can both be wrong the same way is not a mechanical guard).
_provenance: mc39.1-2026-08-29 initial declaration (6 vars, wire-verified by Andrew via `gcloud run services describe fbt-calculator-api ...` 15:12 UTC). mc40-2026-08-29 promoted to canonical JSON manifest.
_discipline: Adding, removing, or renaming an entry MUST land here and NOWHERE ELSE. The pre-deploy live-set delta check (deploy.yml step 'Pre-deploy live env-var-set delta check') fires if the live service carries a name not declared here — mechanical detection of a would-be silent drop. To temporarily bypass the pre-deploy check on legitimate migrations (rare), set CLAWDOG_ENVVAR_SET_GUARD_DISABLE=1 in the workflow env; the bypass emits a loud ::warning:: annotation into the CI log per mc40 Andrew follow-up 2.
